items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Get away from here, kid, can't you see I'm busy.

ctx.x: And all the guys I knew, they were too busy to help us when I came long as kids. This guy was a fantastic trombone player in the '20's with Fletcher Henderson. And he played at Small's Paradise before -- Jimmy Harrison. He could play

but he was drunk all the time, you know. And so, you'd go ask him something about a horn. Get away from here, kid, can't you see I'm busy. He had chicks and all, but that's why I can never turn a kid down today because I think of those things. And actually, the guy probably know too much to tell me anyway because they really didn't know. You know, they hadn't made a scientific study of it. They really just didn't know. He couldn't have -- probably couldn't have told me.

In later years I found out that -- I would look for guys who knew these things and there weren't too many trombone players who know them. Even when I came long with -- Jack Teagarden and myself -- we always used to jam a lot and get together. Brunis and Jack and myself, and we'd run in together. Sit around -- Higginbotham -- we'd jam.
